title: manni artifact-evals strict (1.0.0-proposal.1)
description: The strict overlay for manni:artifact-evals:1.0.0-proposal.4. Stack it beside the open draft, which still owns every key, every required rule and every conditional. Inside `metadata`, it narrows provider and model names, exit codes, companion paths and the assertion hash as the page-side overlay does. It also closes `grader` to the named graders and `tool:` integrations.

metadata.description: Strict narrows the object entries of `metadata.evals`. A string shorthand passes as the open draft reads it, and every other member of `metadata` passes untouched.

meta-provenance.description: Strict holds each entry to the rules the ai-context overlay applies to the same shape. `generated-by` is a model id with no spaces, and each pointer is well formed.

generated-by.description: A model id of letters in either case, digits, `.`, `_`, `:`, `/`, `\`, `@` and `-`, with no spaces. A Windows path to a local model passes.

items.description: A JSON Pointer in which every `~` begins an RFC 6901 escape, `~0` or `~1`.

propertyNames.description: A well-formed JSON Pointer, or a kebab eval id.

entry.description: The rules strict adds to an object entry.

grader.description: One of the ten named graders, or a `tool:<kebab>` integration. Strict accepts no other kebab name.

provider.description: A kebab provider name, such as `anthropic` or `llama-cpp`.

model.description: A model id of letters in either case, digits, `.`, `_`, `:`, `/`, `\`, `@` and `-`, with no spaces. A Windows path to a local model passes.

success-exit-codes.description: Distinct exit codes, each from 0 to 255, the range a process can return.

path.description: A relative path. It starts with no `/`, `\` or `~`, no drive letter, and no URL scheme.
